Resolves #19954

In grids with at least one menu-enabled column (`Wrapper#hasColumnMenus() === true`), `Wrapper#syncColumnMenuState()` toggles `neo-grid-menu-hint` only on header buttons whose effective `columnMenu` is `false` and registers `contextmenu` prevention for that class, while `Neo.main.DomEvents#onContextMenu` leaves editable controls / `.neo-form-field` inputs (`defaultPrevented: false`) and `.neo-grid-menu-trigger` arrows untouched. Right-clicking or pressing `ContextMenu` / `Shift+F10` on a menu-disabled header reuses the active `Neo.grid.header.plugin.Menu` instance's floating surface in hint mode (`cls: ['neo-grid-column-menu-hint']`, `"Value filtering is off for this column."`) without wrapping `columnMenu: false` headers in `.neo-grid-menu-wrapper`, adding trigger buttons, or introducing a second popup lifecycle on `Wrapper` (Round 2 commit `91afcae380` deletes 216 lines / 143 net lines of duplicated popup lifecycle from `src/grid/header/Wrapper.mjs`). Grids with zero menu-enabled columns remain unchanged.

Evidence: L3 (Playwright unit + Chromium Whitebox E2E with Neural Link on port 8194) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2).

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline CI jobs (`pr-body`, `unit-tests`) run on PR open.
